items.raw_excerpt: A 28-year-old man with a rare pulmonary arteriovenous malformation (PAVM) and a cerebral abscess has been successfully treated through a minimally invasive endovascular procedure at HCG Suchirayu Hospital in Hubballi.

items.raw_excerpt: Summer in the Algarve definitely doesn't end with August.
items.summary_en: Summer weather is holding on in Portugal's Algarve region well into September. September 3rd was the fourth hottest September day recorded in mainland Portugal since 1941, with temperatures reaching 27.6°C. Beaches are quieter but warm sunny days continue, with temperatures expected near 30°C this weekend.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 남부 알가르베 지역의 여름 날씨가 9월에도 이어지고 있다. 9월 3일은 1941년 이후 포르투갈 본토에서 네 번째로 더운 9월로 기록됐으며, 전국 평균 기온이 27.6도를 기록했다. 해변은 한산해졌지만 따뜻한 햇살은 계속되고 이번 주말에는 30도 근처까지 오를 전망이다.
items.title_en: Summer is still going strong in the Algarve

items.title_original: Summer is still going strong in the Algarve
